ingredients.item: fresh perilla leaves , stemmed, washed, spun thoroughly dry

instructions.heading: The paint-and-stack, leaf by leaf
instructions.action: The paint-and-stack, leaf by leaf. One leaf on the board, paste painted across its face with a brush or the back of a spoon, the next leaf laid over, painted, the next — the stack becomes the pickle's structure, every layer's seasoning facing the next leaf's face. Ten leaves to a stack, a stack pressed gently, and the stacks stood or laid into the clean jar, pressed down.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: the stack holds together when lifted, and cut at the edge, shows its cross-section: leaf, dark line of seasoning, leaf — the jar's architecture, built.

instructions.heading: Step 2
instructions.action: Any remaining paste and a splash of water over the stack in the jar, pressed once more, and the brine that weeps out over the first hours becomes the jar's own liquid. Lid on, refrigerate.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: by the next morning, the leaves have darkened to deep olive-bronze and the jar holds a shallow soy-amber liquid — the pickle has set. Taste one leaf at 24 hours.

instructions.heading: The 48-hour readiness
instructions.action: The 48-hour readiness. Day one is good; day two is the jar's true voice — the leaf's anise-mint tamed to an herb depth, the brine's soy-sweet in every fold, the texture silky-supple.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: the eating test, one leaf over hot rice: fold, bite — a complex savory-herbal chew that no other pickle on any table resembles. And the ssam use — one leaf wrapping a hot piece of samgyeopsal with a grain of rice — is this site's best single bite between the meat rounds.

storageNotes: Keeps 3–4 weeks refrigerated (a month with dry-leaf discipline), the flavor deepening for two. The wept brine seasons fried rice when the leaves run out.

Variations: chopped into the paste for a spoonable version (the quick bowl); the garlic jar (#B23) shares its shelf; a minced leaf into the ssamjang (#SA01) transplants the perilla voice into every wrap at the table.
